• Contact centres within 2 weeks of signup to confirm program timing meets their schedule and lock in recurring slots before conflicts arise.

• Develop a tiered retention offer for centres considering in-house programs (e.g., co-facilitation, staff training, reduced pricing for extended terms).

• Flag any cancellation notice or rescheduling request as an at-risk account and assign immediate follow-up within 48 hours to understand the underlying issue.
